title: Claim compensation for mine subsidence damage
summary: This page explains how to lodge a claim for compensation if your property has been damaged by mine subsidence.
intro:
If you think your property has been damaged by mine subsidence, you can lodge a claim for compensation through the Subsidence Advisory NSW online portal.

Some types of damage that can occur include:

You will need to lodge a claim within 12 months of becoming aware that the damage was caused by subsidence.

For emergencies:
who_can_apply: Must be the property owner or an authorised representative of the property owner.
what_you_need: Details of all property owners, including relevant proof of authority
The property address, including lot and DP number (if available)
A detailed description of the damage, including photos (if available)
The date you first became aware of the damage

how_to_steps.text: Review the step-by-step process for making a claim.Note: You can also watch a video that explains the process.
Log in, or create a MyServiceNSW Account. You will then be directed to the portal homepage.
Under 'Draft claims', select 'Create' to start a claim.
Follow the prompts to complete your application, and upload any documents (including photos of the damage) to support your claim.

more_info.text: You can log in to the Subsidence Advisory NSW Portal to track and manage your claim.

faqs.q: Who can lodge a claim for mine subsidence damage?
faqs.a: You must be the property owner or an authorised representative of the property owner.

faqs.q: How long do I have to lodge a claim?
faqs.a: You must lodge a claim within 12 months of becoming aware that the damage was caused by subsidence.

faqs.q: What do I need to start a claim?
faqs.a: You need a MyServiceNSW Account, your details and the details of all property owners (including proof of authority), the property address (including lot and DP number), a detailed description of the damage (including photos), and the date you first became aware of the damage.
